description: The saas-signup template starts in monitor, so its recommendations are recorded but not enforced.
policy:
# Posterna policy: the saas-signup template.
#
# The allow-list template, plus recommendations for the sign-up page:
# verified agents can skip a friction step, and failed claims and unknown
# automation get your own challenge. Your application acts on these
# recommendations; Posterna never shows a challenge itself. It starts in
# monitor mode, so nothing is blocked or recommended until you change mode
# to enforce. The reference for every key is docs/policy.md in the
# posternahq/posterna repository.

version: 1
mode: monitor

# By verdict class. People are always allowed and are not configured here.
defaults:
  verified: allow
  declared_unverifiable: allow
  claimed_failed: allow
  unknown_automation: allow

# Verified search engines are never blocked or throttled.
guards:
  search_engines: protect

# Applies to every operator.
purposes:
  training: block

# Returned by decide(result, { path, kind: "signup" }) for your application to act on.
signup:
  "/signup":
    verified: lift
    claimed_failed: challenge
    unknown_automation: challenge

# What `posterna robots` prints, for you to copy into your own robots.txt.
# Posterna never serves robots.txt itself.
emit: [robots.txt, content-signals]
